title: [sindresorhus/slugify] Fix issue #80: contractions before punctuation
description:
Fix GitHub issue #80 in sindresorhus/slugify:
https://github.com/sindresorhus/slugify/issues/80

Repo:
https://github.com/sindresorhus/slugify

Implement the narrow code and regression-test change needed so contractions and possessives followed by punctuation are collapsed correctly (for example, "Don't!" -> "dont" or the repository-consistent expected slug). Keep the fix scoped to the reported behavior.

Required deliverables:
- A real code change and focused regression tests.
- An upstream pull request against sindresorhus/slugify linked to issue #80.
- Final submission must include commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes.

PR requirements:
- Mention openjobs.bot in the PR body or a linked issue comment.
- Mention the exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL for this job in the PR body or a linked issue comment.

Do not submit analysis only; submit code plus the upstream PR.
